title: Extended null calibration: per-register, per-decoder-mode and panel-max thresholds for the Round-19 instrument
hypothesis: For each (register, decoder transition relation, segment length) cell, the maximum of N i.i.d. null score draws is Gumbel-distributed with cell-specific (mu, beta), so a family-wise bar can be stated for any N.

instrument.null_generator: wrong-key BEAM decodes: uniform random rune ciphertext x uniform random 29-ary keystream, decoded by the full skip-aware beam. NOT random rune strings. Control: histogram-preserving shuffle of the real 12,956-rune LP2 unsolved stream, agreeing in beta to 14.5% (EN_QUAD) and 4.8% (panel_max).
decoders: round19/I1/driftbeam.beam_decode PRESETS exact, exact_ms8, pair, drift
adjudicators: round19/I2/adjudicate.adjudicate -> en, pmax, pmax_ne, pcon, z[9]
9 rune-space trigram register LMs (this lane's own panel)
instrument.fitters: block-maxima Gumbel (MLE), GPD peaks-over-threshold, free-shape GEV, plus the repo's two-point order-statistic solve, reported side by side

coverage: 91 null cells, ~9.6e6 wrong-key beam decodes. 9 registers x segment lengths {31,120,240} at beam_w 400; 9 decoder transition relations (keyskip1, skip_by_two, drift1-3, union{2,4,6,8}) at L=120; 4 (L, beam_w=120) geometries {25,31,40,400} matching R17's actual escalation settings; 4 I1 presets x 13 I2 statistics; 2 panel-combination rules (max-z and min-p PIT); a shuffle-null control on the real ciphertext; 3 plants; 14 historical sweep stages of Rounds 13/16/17 re-derived at their own adjudicated decode counts.
not_covered: M >= 1e6 for 71 of 91 cells. Those bars are PROVISIONAL: their false-positive rate is unverified at the pre-registered precision, not known to be wrong. Reasons and throughput in RESULTS.md 9.1; the exact re-run is in RESULTS.md 12.
Segment lengths outside {25,31,40,120,240,400}. L=100, 262 and 12,956 appear in the G-HONEST table as extrapolations along the fitted beta ~ L^-0.583 law and are flagged as such.
Signs other than -1, and non-uniform / low-entropy key material (L7-B.1 shows the decoder behaves differently on constant-byte runs).
I1's n_skips statistic has NO null curve here and must not be thresholded until it does. It is language-independent and is this lane's top recommended addition.
I2's ioc, mds, h2, zl have no null curve here; only en, pmax, pmax_ne, pcon and the nine z's are calibrated.
Combinations of transition-relation axes; each mode was measured alone.
A decoder-output-standardised panel z (INTERFACE R-I2-2b). The BARS are on the decoder-output null and are correct; I2's internal z SCALE is not, and rule 7 of the contract says so.

gates.G-CAL: PARTIAL - 41/46 cells at M>=1e6 within 20% of nominal; 5 fail, EVERY failure conservative (worst 26% at alpha=0.01, 46% at alpha=0.05, all at the largest gating block size, the xi<0 signature). No published bar manufactures false positives.
gates.G-CAL-X: PASSED - 52/52 out-of-sample extrapolation checks within 1.0 Gumbel SD of the prediction from block sizes n<=1e3; worst residual -0.30 SD.
gates.G-RECOVER: PARTIAL - PASSED for exact/pair/exact_ms8 (the correction increases power: Latin 0.75->1.00, German 0.67->1.00, Welsh 0.08->1.00, vowel-dropped English 0.00->0.67, negative control 0.00). FAILED for I1's drift preset on Old English (median pmax 13.40 vs bar 13.84); tradeoff quantified in RESULTS.md 7.2.
gates.G-BACKCOMPAT: PASSED - threshold_for(n) and threshold_for(n, L) bit-identical to benchmark/null.py over 13 trial counts x 6 segment lengths x 4 alphas x 4 (mu,beta,floor) triples, 0 differences; 8 benchmark gates still pass; 15/15 lane tests pass. Independently cross-validated: I1's separate block-maxima fit (mu=-7.247, beta=0.0665) reproduces the published DEFAULT_MU=-7.2517 / BETA=0.0725.
gates.G-HONEST: PASSED - all 14 sweep stages of Rounds 13/16/17 tabulated with the bar each should have used at its own adjudicated decode count, segment length and beam width. 0/14 verdicts flip.
gates.G-PANEL: FAILED - the two pre-registered estimators disagree by 2.06-2.45x against a 1.5x criterion. This is a finding: no single effective-test count describes the panel. Estimates span 4.2-16.5 across lanes, lengths and tail depths. Resolution: adopt R1's recommendation and calibrate a direct null on the panel maximum, which this lane did.
gates.PREREG-Q5-kill-condition: NOT MET - the vectorised engine reproduces skipdecode.beam_decode's score to <=1.2e-14 on 600/600 random cases at L in {31,120,240}, and plain_idx identically on 600/600.

key_findings: The repo's own constants survive a 1e6-sample audit. Measured L=120 mu=-7.0890, beta=0.06814 against published -7.2517 / 0.0725; the resulting BAR differs by only 0.04-0.08 at every N, and the measured one is slightly stricter. L7-C.3's criticism of the METHOD (zero degrees of freedom, circular) was correct; the NUMBERS are right.

-5.5 is a valid alpha=0.01 family-wise bar over a range of N spanning TWELVE orders of magnitude depending on geometry: N<=37 at (L=25, bw=120), N<=208 at (L=31,bw=120), N<=1.35e8 at (L=120,bw=400), N<=1.1e14 at (L=400,bw=120).

Covering L7-B's skip_by_two hole is essentially FREE: the pair-constrained relation shifts the null by -0.002 (this lane's proxy) / +0.019 (I1's actual PRESETS['pair']). The single most consequential decoder gap Round 18 found costs about two hundredths of a score unit.
Unconstrained drift is ruinous and a PENALTY is far more efficient than a CAP: drift1 and union6 produce the same realised drift (0.500 vs 0.493) but shift the null +1.628 vs +0.699, a factor of 2.3.

The extreme-value tail is BOUNDED, not Gumbel: xi<0 in 46/46 cells with M>=1e6 (range -0.117..-0.004, mean -0.064), Gumbel rejected in 36/46. On a planted true Gumbel the same fitter returns xi=-0.009 with a CI containing zero, so this is data not estimator. Consequence: the Gumbel bar is CONSERVATIVE by 0.07-0.56 over N=1e4..1e10. PREREG 2 stated this direction backwards and the correction is published.

Dropping the unjustified -5.5 floor for the properly scale-corrected family-wise bar - changing nothing else, not the decoder and not the scorer - raises measured power at a VERIFIED alpha=0.01 over 1e6 decodes: Latin 0.75->1.00, German 0.67->1.00, Old English 0.67->0.92, half-vowel English 0.50->0.83. A large part of what L7-A diagnosed as an English-only SCORER was an English-only BAR.

Under I1's drift preset a WRONG key on random ciphertext reaches en=-5.351 in only 15,000 trials - it crosses the repo's historical -5.5 confirm bar - and pmax=9.33 against I2's random-rune null max of 1.163. Had Phase 2 adjudicated against anything like the nominal z scale, every decode would have been a hit.

L7-C.6's repo-wide decode tally is inflated 6.7x by the same offsets-vs-decodes error it identified in R17: the corrected adjudicated total is 2,535,325,467, not 17,058,157,809, and the repo-wide alpha=0.01 bar is -5.300, not -5.210. The qualitative claim (the repo-wide bar is stricter than -5.5) survives.

Independent cross-validation with I2: at L=120 the per-decode 1e-3 quantile of the wrong-key beam null agrees to 0.026 on en (-6.6133 vs -6.6396) and 0.080 on pmax (4.3496 vs 4.2773), across two null sources and a 125x difference in sample size.

g_honest_summary.too_strict: 12 of 14, by +0.12 to +1.19. At R17's own geometry (L=400) the correct bar is ~-6.6, and L7-A.1's correct-key medians for Latin (-5.55), OE (-5.45), DE (-5.48) and half-vowel English (-5.68) all clear it while all fail -5.5. Caveat: R17 also ran an English trigram prefilter whose non-English survival was never measured, so fixing the bar raises the ADJUDICATOR's power, not necessarily the lane's coverage.
g_honest_summary.too_loose: 2 of 14, both R17-P3, by -0.52 and -0.63. P3's headline -5.679 was scored on a 31-rune head; the correct alpha=0.01 bar at its own 25,080 adjudicated decodes is -4.872, so the '0.18 short of a hit' framing understates the gap 4.5x - it was 0.81 short. Across ~4,600 P3-ms8 decodes on 25-42 rune heads the expected number of null crossings of -5.5 is 0.2-1.2.
g_honest_summary.threshold_for_misuse: confirmed in 4 of 4 R17 lanes that called it: the offset count was passed instead of the adjudicated decode count, an inflation of 1e5-1e6x per lane.

threshold_contract: RESULTS.md section 10. Two tiers: ESCALATE alpha=0.05 per lane, CLAIM alpha=0.01 round-wide over adjudicated decodes. Claim on pmax, never on en under a permissive preset. Headline cells at L=120, N=1e6, alpha=0.01: exact/en -5.829, exact/pmax 7.634, pair/pmax 7.384, drift/en -4.453, drift/pmax 13.842. L=31 cells for G1/G2 in section 10.0.

family_wise_error_target.allocation: union bound over the ROUND's total adjudicated decode count; every lane calls threshold_for at N_round, not N_lane. Conservative because decodes are not independent (the same 12,956 runes are re-decoded), which is the safe direction for a negative.
family_wise_error_target.claim_statistic: pmax, one statistic. en, pmax_ne, pcon, ioc, mds, h2, zl are persisted diagnostics. A lane claiming on k statistics splits alpha k ways.
family_wise_error_target.defence: alpha=0.001 was rejected on measured evidence, not taste: it raises the L=120 bar by 0.158 and costs Latin 1.00->0.83, OE 0.92->0.75, DE 1.00->0.92, half-vowel 0.83->0.67 at N=1e6, i.e. exactly the registers this round exists to recover, while leaving English and LP1 untouched. alpha=0.05 round-wide would mean a 1-in-20 chance that the round designed to fix false positives commits one.

reopens_if: I1 changes any PRESETS entry (voids that preset's cells); I2 rebuilds models/panel.npz (voids every pmax/pcon/z cell); driftbeam.beam_decode starts returning the PENALISED score (voids every en cell); a Phase-2 lane needs a segment length or beam width outside the measured grid; or a keystream family whose null is not uniform-random-like. See INTERFACE.md section 4.
